LanguageData.CC_Son_HuntersText: {ENEMY} have heard that the colony took in {SON}, the son of {DEAD}, and they have come for him.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Why_son: {LEADER} leads them: the warlord's son, come to avenge his father on the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Why_sonOfMother: {LEADER} leads them: the warlord's son, come to avenge his mother on the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_Visitor: We passed the fires of a {KIND} on the road from the {DIR}, you should know.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Text_Visitor: {SPOTTER} of {DOING}, here at the colony, came past the fires of a camp on the road: {PEOPLE} have made a {KIND} {WHERE}, near enough to strike at {COLONY}.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Line_Visitor: {SPOTTER}, a visitor, warned of a {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Text_Letter: Word has come from {TOWN} of {DOING}: their people on the road have seen the fires of a camp {WHERE}. {PEOPLE} have made a {KIND} there, near enough to strike at {COLONY}, and {TOWN} thought the colony should know.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Line_Letter: Word from {TOWN} told of a {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Grown_History: {PLACE} of {FACTION} grew from a settlers' steading into a town.
